links.to_node: I do not prevent my colleague's reorganization of the library's book collection.
The library's book collection is reorganized by my colleague.
Library patrons experience a brief period where certain books are inaccessible due to the reorganization.
The overall user experience for library patrons improves after reorganization.
The mandatory library audit still causes temporary inaccessibility of some books.
I support the colleague's initiative, potentially strengthening our working relationship.
